about: The acceptance thresholds of the sound pass: one entry per check, keyed by its ID in sound/BIBLE.md §9 (plus the packs' own rules).

This file is the single source of truth. sound/checks/ (node src/cli.mjs verify) and the symbolic score checks the audit runs (src/sound/scorecheck.mjs) read every threshold from here; nothing else hardcodes one.

Resolution: an entry's top-level values apply to every look; `looks.<look>` replaces individual keys for that look ('*' is the fallback for a look not listed). A check whose entry ends up with no thresholds for a look is skipped for it.

`gate: false` reports the measurement without failing. `pending` marks a value that passes today but differs from the bible's text: it carries what the bible says, what passes now and why; the bible owner syncs §9 (or changes the pack) and then removes the marker. Bible v2 (2026-10-12) synced §9 with this file and resolved the seven v1 markers; one owner decision is pending (A8's correlation target for Becker Rig).
The bible's §9 tables mirror this file threshold for threshold (§9.0): change both in the same pass.
Meta keys (never thresholds): bible, name, on, note, method, pending, gate, looks, manual.

A1.name: Integrated loudness
A1.on: delivery: the decoded AAC (BS.1770-4, src/sound/loudness.mjs); master: report.loudness.integrated

A2.name: True peak (decoded AAC)
A2.on: the worst of the 4x JS meter on the decoded AAC and ffmpeg ebur128 (report.loudness.postEncode.ffmpeg.TP, when the build ran with the ffmpeg cross-check)

A5.name: PLR (true peak - integrated)
A5.on: delivery: A2's true peak minus A1's integrated
A5.note: The engine enforces the upper bound (bible §8.6 step 9): its encode loop retries, locally then globally, until the decoded PLR is <= PLR_MAX - 0.05 (src/sound/engine.mjs, PLR_MAX = 13.0; test/acceptance.test.mjs checks that it equals max).

A7.name: Hook
A7.on: delivery: momentary loudness of the window 0-0.4 s

A8.name: Mono compatibility
A8.on: delivery: Pearson L/R correlation per 400 ms window (silent windows skipped), mono fold = 0.5(L+R)

pending.bibleSays: §9.1 A8: mean L/R correlation >= 0.30 (gated), with a target of 0.45-0.85 (not gated).
pending.passesNow: The gate holds on all 30. Scoreboard measures 0.73-0.79, inside the target; Becker Rig measures 0.87-0.92 on all 15, over it (mono fold -0.28..-0.44 LU, so nothing is lost in mono).
pending.reason: Found in the v2 sync (2026-10-12), not decided: Becker Rig's returns sit 9.4-12.3 LU under the mix (Scoreboard's about 6) and its band is centred or panned narrow (kick, bass, snare, clap and brass centred; marimba +-30% by pitch, pizz +-20%, glock -10..+35%, shaker +18..+30%), so little decorrelated energy reaches the mix. Whether that is too narrow is a design call, not a measurement fix.
pending.sync: The owner decides: either §9.1 A8's target becomes 0.45-0.92 for Becker Rig (its width is the dry toy-box design, §6.7.3), or the pack widens (pan spread, room width) towards 0.85 and refits (§11.2). Then sync §9.1 and remove this marker; npm test needs no marker to remain.

A10.name: Phone proxy
A10.on: delivery: HP 250 Hz 4th order (two 2nd-order Butterworths), drop in integrated loudness

A12.name: Delivery format
A12.on: ffprobe of the muxed MP4 (or the .m4a when no picture was muxed)

A13.name: Picture untouched
A13.on: video-stream md5 of the muxed MP4 vs the source (needs the finished MP4s: --video, default ../renders/channel)

A14.name: Determinism
A14.on: master WAV sha256: equals the hash the engine wrote into the report; differs between specs; with --twice, equals a second render's

BANDS.name: Octave-band balance
BANDS.on: delivery over [0, base]: Hann 8192, 50% overlap, dB re the 1 kHz octave (src/sound/audit.mjs bandBalance)

scoreboard.note: 31.5 Hz is -20..+3 (bible v1: -8..+3): with SB-Kick's 48 Hz tail and the 808 on 58-110 Hz the octave measures about -15 to -19; v1's -8 was reachable only by tuning the kick to D1 for the meter (bible §9.2).

HARSH.name: Harshness
HARSH.on: delivery: the 2-5 kHz band over the regression line through the 500 Hz-8 kHz octaves

SPECTROGRAM.name: Spectrogram
SPECTROGRAM.note: Not automated: look at the PNGs `node src/cli.mjs audit <dir> --out <dir>` writes (stripes at P and L, partials, no falling mirror lines under a riser, no wall above 16 kHz).

B1.name: Stem balance
B1.on: report.stems (gated LUFS re the mix, after the master gain, before the limiter)

scoreboard.note: The windows assume the returns stem at about -6 LU re the mix (bible §8.1): reported, not gated. The pack trims its returns bus +2.5 dB for it (looks/scoreboard/sound/mix.mjs `returns`).

becker-rig.note: bible §8.1: music -0.5..-4.5 LU re the mix; gated SFX minus gated music in [-2, +2] LU; returns <= -8 LU. `asWritten` holds bible v1's two bands, reported as B1w (never gated).

B3.name: Cue audibility
B3.on: sfx stem vs music stem RMS over [t, t + windowS]

scoreboard.note: Card cues (t >= base) are reported, not gated (bible §9.3): the sting holds over the card and its handle cues are texture under it.

B4.name: Onsets
B4.on: report.cueStart (first sample above -60 dBFS of each solo-rendered cue, in the master's level)

B5.name: Payoff in audio
B5.on: music stem, onset nearest P within +-searchS

becker-rig.note: The steepest rise of 2 ms-frame energy (HP 100 Hz), bible §9.3: the reverse crash ending at P and the brass 'ka' scoop make the flux peak lead P by a frame and a half (-8.0 ms on all 15).

B6.name: Continuity
B6.on: music.dry short-term loudness (3 s windows ending in [3 s, base]) vs its own integrated loudness
B6.note: No exemption (bible v2 §9.3): a 3 s window never falls 18 LU for the TENSION gap (at most 0.27 s). v1 exempted the gap.

B7.name: Energy curve
B7.on: music.dry short-term loudness sampled every 100 ms, both on windows ending at t (edge) and centred on t (clipped at base); both must pass

B8.name: Logo
B8.on: delivery momentary loudness of the windows ending at L + atS and P + atS

B9.name: Card tail
B9.on: master WAV: no 50 ms window (louder channel) below thrDbfs in [base, duration - fadeS]; the last sample 0
B9.note: The cosine shape of the final fade is the engine's (masterMix edges); it is not measured.

B10.name: Flams
B10.on: score: music kick/snare/clap onsets vs strong cues; anchors (0, P, V, base) never yield (engine decision 6)

S1.name: In key
S1.on: score: pitched body notes in the key or the sounding chord, or flagged chromatic
S1.note: Not automated (as before this harness): that each flagged chromatic note moves by <= 2 st within 1 beat to a chord tone.

S2.name: Chord tones on strong beats
S2.on: score: notes within tolMs of beats 1 and 3

S3.name: Registers (MIDI, inclusive)
S3.on: score: pitched body notes by role; pitched SFX layers
S3.note: The windows include the bible's octave pops and doublings (808 pops <= 57 and the P/L sub at 26; arp octave copy <= 98; BR bass pops <= 61; fanfare doubling <= 86).

S4.name: Bass on the downbeat
S4.on: score: the bass note within tolMs of each bar line is the chord's written bass

S5.name: Repetition
S5.on: score: bar fingerprints (instrument, 1/gridDiv-bar position, MIDI, velocity to 0.1)
S5.note: Not automated (as before this harness): 'no 2-bar lead or glock phrase more than twice'.

S6.name: Anchors
S6.on: score: bar line, kick, bass and crash/stab at P; no note-on in [P - 1 eighth, P) but the reverse crash

S8.name: Humanising
S8.note: bible §9.4 S8. Velocity SD: gated for Becker Rig (>= 8 body events, accent-only voices excluded), reported for Scoreboard, whose raw SD is its written accents (the score keeps accent x jitter). The 58% swing is the grid the shaker is judged against. A drum merged onto a cue onset (|dt| <= 1 ms) is exempt from the on-grid rule.

S9.name: Tempo
S9.on: score.tempo: segment 1 in [lo, hi]; later segments in [absLo, absHi] and within maxDev of BPM1 (maxDevV when V is anchored)
S9.note: The look ranges must equal the engine's LOOK_DEFAULTS and the packs' `tempo` (test/acceptance.test.mjs checks it).

S10.name: Frame 1
S10.on: score: kick, 808/bass and stab/brass events within tolMs of t = 0

S11.name: Energy plan
S11.note: Not automated (as before this harness): the TENSION rule (no kick or clap backbeat for Scoreboard, a heartbeat kick for Becker Rig).

S12.name: Voice leading
S12.on: score: pad voices between consecutive chords (not across P)

S13.name: Melody
S13.on: score: lead/glock/melody roles, phrases split at gaps > phraseGapS

S14.name: Polyphony
S14.on: score: pitched body notes sounding at once
S14.note: Counts every pitched body note for its whole written duration (bible v2 §9.4). v1 excluded tails below -30 dB; this is stricter. All 30 teasers measure exactly 12.

U1.name: Aliasing
U1.on: each pitched voice at D6 and A6 for 1 s: off-series spectral peaks re the fundamental

U2.name: Clicks
U2.on: the first and last 1 ms of every voice and SFX buffer (transient-led starts exempt)

U3.name: Bounds
U3.on: no NaN/Inf; each SFX at gain 1 within its palette peak + overDb
U3.note: Peaks are the §5 / §7 palette columns (Scoreboard type at -16, the tick train as built; Becker hit at -4 for every hit, so the big variant's -3 is the limit). Scoreboard renders each kind solo on a synthetic timeline; Becker renders every cue of the 15 Becker teasers.

U4.name: Variation
U4.on: two consecutive same-kind cues rendered solo: normalised cross-correlation
U4.note: Scoreboard's buzz is exempt: the bible gives it no variation (one per teaser). Scoreboard compares two solo renders at lag 0 on the left channel; Becker compares consecutive cues of each Becker teaser (mono, best of lags 0, ±1, ±2 ms).

TRAIN.name: Clock trains never flam
TRAIN.on: score: music kick/clap/snare/hat and arp/lead/stab onsets vs clock-train ticks (anchors excepted)

DUCK.name: The B3 clearance stays band-selective
DUCK.on: score.sfx[].duck vs the pack's §5 table (mix.mjs duck/duckBig), scaled by clamp(gain/0.7, 0.3, 1.2)

LOGO.name: The sting's long note leads
LOGO.on: units: n4's RMS over the first windowMs vs each pickup's, solo at the mix levels

MALLET.name: The marimba carries the BUILD
MALLET.on: the BUILD re-rendered per instrument (pre glue/duck, with musicDb and the voice automation): marimba K-weighted loudness re the band, and the loudest voice in 500-1200 Hz

FLAMS.name: No flams against body cues or clock ticks
FLAMS.on: score: music kick/snare/clap/tom 15-70 ms off a body cue >= minGain or a clock-train tick/thud (anchors excepted)

B1w.name: B1 v1 bands (Becker: reported)
B1w.on: report.stems vs the B1 asWritten windows (bible v1's music and SFX bands)

INFO.bible: §9.7 (every look: AAC0; Becker Rig: the critic's measurements)
INFO.name: Reported, never gated
INFO.on: B1u (SFX ungated re mix, the SFX's own contribution), REACT (the react-bus voices and the duck curve under them), DUCKSTATS (body share >= 6 dB down, dips > 6 dB per minute, per-kind duck depths), FOLEY (in-band audibility of tick/step/roll/whoosh), DEFLATE (the Gm span and the bass bends), AAC0 (decoded true peak in the first 30 ms re the master's)
